hibernate-mapping.query: from License as license where license.code= :code and license.reseller.id= :resellerId
from License as license where license.code= :code and license.account.id= :userId and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='N'

from License as license where license.code= :code and ( (license.regCode=0 and license.account is NULL) or (license.regCode=1 and license.numUses < license.maxUses) ) and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='N'
from License as license where license.code= :code and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='N'
select count(license) from License as license where license.code= :code and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.rc='N'
from License as license where license.code like :code and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.rcusage.id is NULL and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='N'
from License as license where license.code= :code and license.rcusage.id= :userId and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='Y'

from License as license where license.code= :code and ((license.rcusage is NULL and license.regCode=0) or (license.regCode=1 and license.numUses < license.maxUses) ) and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='Y'
from License as license where license.code= :code and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.revoked=0 and license.rc='Y'
select count(license) from License as license where license.code= :code and license.reseller.id= :resellerId and license.rc='Y'
